context.outcome: Authenticated users can compare projects and inspect task status through reusable dashboard cards, tables, filters and board views.
context.scope: Existing user-authorized projects and project-scoped tasks

policies: Existing Identity and API authorization remains authoritative
invariants: Only API-returned records contribute to displayed metrics
Filtered task summaries explicitly identify their scope

readModels.name: Dashboard summary
readModels.purpose: Compare active/archived projects and task counts

boundaries.bff: Projects layer authenticated and validated routes
boundaries.identity: Existing projects consumer session and server authorization

acceptanceCriteria: Overview shows accurate project metrics and searchable sortable paginated project table
Tasks offers table and board views using existing API records and write operations
Loading, empty, error, retry and submission feedback are visible
English and French labels, mobile reflow and accessible controls
Real task metrics remain API-backed; billing and activity fixtures are explicitly labeled demo data

assumptions.statement: Current contracts have no timestamps, assignees or due dates; historical charts and overdue metrics are excluded

decisions: Presentation-only: no domain state, API contracts, permissions or persistence changes
Use existing Nuxt UI 4 table/card/progress/dashboard primitives

Isolate billing and activity as presentation-only fixtures, with no payment or invoice mutations. Keep overview queries to the project collection; task status metrics remain project-scoped rather than fetching every project's tasks
Keep orchestration in feature composables and reusable UI in feature components
problem: Tasks currently emphasizes architectural examples over reusable dashboard data views.
invariants: Only API-returned records contribute to displayed metrics
Filtered task summaries explicitly identify their scope
